text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk, pathetic. Not with running this 
dull...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "Don't mind me! Just do... your own job!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, so weak, so weak...! Getting worn 
out from just this...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"More, run more... I refuse... to let 
myself go soft...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue prevented her from getting 
results, and frustration and irritation 
began to mount... A vicious cycle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushing any further is out of the 
question. We should probably reconsider 
the race schedule...
